env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.100.0
env TESTGO_VERSION_SWITCH=switch

bolero get toolchain@go1.22.1
stderr '^bolero: added toolchain go1.22.1$'
! stderr '(added|removed|upgraded|downgraded) go'
grep 'toolchain go1.22.1' go.mod

bolero get toolchain@none
stderr '^bolero: removed toolchain go1.22.1$'
! stderr '(added|removed|upgraded|downgraded) go'
! grep toolchain go.mod

bolero get toolchain@go1.22.1
stderr '^bolero: added toolchain go1.22.1$'
! stderr '(added|removed|upgraded|downgraded) go'
grep 'toolchain go1.22.1' go.mod

bolero get go@1.22.3
stderr '^bolero: upgraded go 1.10 => 1.22.3$'
! stderr '^bolero: upgraded toolchain$'
grep 'go 1.22.3' go.mod

bolero get toolchain@go1.100.0
stderr '^bolero: added toolchain go1.100.0$'

bolero get go@1.22.3 toolchain@1.22.3
stderr '^bolero: removed toolchain go1.100.0$'
! grep toolchain go.mod

bolero get go@1.22.1 toolchain@go1.22.3
stderr '^bolero: downgraded go 1.22.3 => 1.22.1$'
stderr '^bolero: added toolchain go1.22.3$'
grep 'go 1.22.1' go.mod
grep 'toolchain go1.22.3' go.mod

bolero get go@1.22.3 toolchain@1.22.3
stderr '^bolero: upgraded go 1.22.1 => 1.22.3$'
stderr '^bolero: removed toolchain go1.22.3$'
grep 'go 1.22.3' go.mod
! grep toolchain go.mod

bolero get toolchain@1.22.1
stderr '^bolero: downgraded go 1.22.3 => 1.22.1$'
! stderr toolchain # already gone, was not added
grep 'go 1.22.1' go.mod
! grep toolchain go.mod

env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.22.1
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
! bolero get go@1.22.3
stderr 'bolero: updating go.mod requires go >= 1.22.3 \(running go 1.22.1; BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local\)$'

env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.30
bolero get toolchain@1.22.3
grep 'toolchain go1.22.3' go.mod

bolero get go@1.22.1
grep 'go 1.22.1' go.mod
bolero get m2@v1.0.0
stderr '^bolero: upgraded go 1.22.1 => 1.23$'
stderr '^bolero: added m2 v1.0.0$'
grep 'go 1.23$' go.mod

bolero get toolchain@go1.23.9 go@1.23.5
bolero get toolchain@none
stderr '^bolero: removed toolchain go1.23.9'
! stderr ' go 1'
grep 'go 1.23.5' go.mod

bolero get toolchain@go1.23.0 go@1.22.0
bolero get go@1.24.0
! grep toolchain go.mod

-- go.mod --
module m
go 1.10

replace m2 v1.0.0 => ./m2

-- m2/go.mod --
module m2
go 1.23
